concerns.action: submit_attempt + issue_attempt_nonce REVOKEd from authenticated, GRANTed service_role-only (trusted server action is sole caller). Removed p_secret param; HMAC verified against app.hmac_secret() (private app.app_secrets, definer-only, value set out-of-band/never committed). p_correct now only suppliable by the service-role server, which computed it via the lib grader — not client-forgeable.

Split out app.forbid_mutation_erasable (student_attempts only), TG_OP-aware: BEFORE UPDATE returns NEW so the anonymizing SET persists (returning OLD no-ops). Re-pointed the student_attempts trigger; forbid_mutation stays strict.

Erase exception isolated to the dedicated forbid_mutation_erasable on student_attempts ONLY; mastery_updates/messages/consent_events/record_access_log/tutor_exchanges keep the strict shared forbid_mutation -> legal/audit tables remain strictly append-only during an erase.
read_student_record authorizes via can_read_raw_evidence(student_campus) (campus_admin/super_admin) instead of the guardian-only assert; reason required; audits before returning.

issue_attempt_nonce now requires exists(sessions where id=p_session and student_id=p_student) before issuing; the nonce row binds student+session, so submit consumes only a session that belongs to the student.

note: Codexreview caught 2 blocking forgery/correctness bugs in untestable SQL before commit -- the intended safety net. All 5 fixed; re-verifying round 2.
